name: Znect Screen Bridge
description: Concept-stage Android screen-sharing bridge with user-controlled capture and provider-neutral AI/client adapters; implementation deferred until the Znect Forge foundation is established.
permissions: Android MediaProjection consent for screen capture (not implemented)
Foreground service and notification for an active capture session (not implemented)
Optional overlay permission for floating controls (not implemented)
Network access only for a user-configured authenticated and encrypted client transport (not implemented)
dependencies: Android SDK (target version to be selected during implementation)
limitations: No screen capture, overlay, transport, or AI adapter has been implemented
ChatGPT continuous screen/video access is not guaranteed by a ChatGPT Free subscription
OpenAI API usage is separate from ChatGPT subscription and billing
No compatibility, privacy, or security testing has been performed
Implementation intentionally deferred until after the Znect Forge foundation
